environment.description: EKS pod with container-level securityContext specifying readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or projected volumes are mounted except the service account token (automountServiceAccountToken is set to false at the ServiceAccount level via annotation but the projected volume for the bound token at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount is still present due to EKS IRSA OIDC token injection). The container runs as non-root uid 65534. The pod spec does NOT include any writable volume mounts (no emptyDir, no PVC, no tmpfs). The /app/data directory is baked into the container image at build time and becomes read-only at runtime. Seccomp profile set to RuntimeDefault. The node uses containerd with default AppArmor profile applied.

config.notes: No volumeMounts defined. Container rootfs is entirely read-only. /tmp is part of rootfs (no tmpfs overlay). Service account token projection disabled.
